sub_text: Receive the booking by email or web — written confirmation only. A completed SLI form is required unless it's an eBooking via iCON or Quote & Book.
Validate the booking to ensure no mandatory information is missing.
Validate prohibited and restricted ocean cargoes into CW1.
Validate that no mandatory information is missing from the booking.
Validate the commodity — check for potential DG or special handling.
If mandatory information is missing, contact the customer to get the data.
Check the Local Client, Shipper or Consignee CW1 Org Code exists and verify screening status is CLR.
If the code does not exist, coordinate with the GBS MDM team to create it following the Organisation SOP, then screen.
Send a booking acknowledgement to the customer after receiving the SLI or email.
Use Published Sailing Schedules, customer SOP and requirements, and overseas office input to select the best routing.

sub_text: Carrier checklist: customer SOP carrier list; Cargo Ready Date / Target ETD; valid quotation or rates; space allocation and sailing options; cost per option.
